top_strength: Joanna gathered comprehensive logistics details (addresses, square footage, room count, special items, packing preference, box count estimate, parking, storage stop) and delivered both core promises (On-Time Guarantee and No Worries Damage Coverage) clearly before routing to walkthrough.
coaching_note: When a customer says 'not really' to the two-concerns question, probe deeper with 'tell me more' rather than accepting the surface answer — they may have unstated worries that surface in follow-up, and it strengthens the positioning of the promises that follow.
